notes.content:
The effect of the passive skill "Addict" has been changed:
    From: Triggered when addicted to substances
    To: Triggered when affected by the effects of addictive substances.

Fixed an issue where players could run outside the map in certain areas of the forest zone.
Corrected a bug where the addiction debuff from "Devil's Deal" was not being negated by the effects of "Devil's Deal" after becoming addicted.
Fixed an issue in the Flower Field area where certain maps could cause random teleport destination errors.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
1.12
Fixed an issue with the display of supply counts available to players in the final area's supply mission.
The Demon Face Spider can now only be killed once; it will not appear again afterward.
Corrected the description of a psychic stone tablet in the final chapter's area.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Fixed the issue where players would get stuck at the portal when arriving at the Sky Islands in the Flower Fields.
The puzzle event for the Coin Relic will now provide hints to inform players when it is completed.
Corrected an icon error for a specific treasure chest.
Now, after a specific protagonist, Kola will no longer be left in the Void when returning to the human world.
Time will pause when using the Coin Relic.

Fixed the issue where the Devil's Deal could not be cured by the Addiction Antidote.
Modified a portion of the English translation.

Fixed an issue where if the player first spend money on allowing companions to learn combo skills, then later added Hibiki to the team, she would be unable to learn dagger skills.
AI Update: If the player has learned 'AOE Energy Absorption,' the auto-battle AI will use it when VE is below 50%.
Fixed an issue in the sea monster event where choosing to flee would result in a black screen.

Fixed the issue where some passive skills' damage or healing could trigger decimal points.
    The doctor will now only speak to you once.
    The revival time for the Eye Demon’s eyeball has been changed from every 10 turns to every 5 turns.
    Fixed the bug where you could continuously learn suicide in the Supervision Department.

Fixed the bug in the mirror world puzzle where the energy ball did not remember the position after the player moved it to the target position and locked it.
Also improved the position of random event generation to prevent the player from being unable to complete the puzzle.

Removed some pre-loaded images to reduce memory usage.
Added a safety measure, now the protagonist will be forced to be in the team before entering the important plot.
Fixed the issue where part of the story before the final battle was not translated

1.09 Patch Notes

    Weapon Body Combined Reworked: Effects changed to:
    +25% ATK
    When you use a physical attack, there is a 33% chance to further increase damage by 25%, while also inflicting 10% of that damage as recoil to yourself.

    Fixed the issue where the icon did not disappear after #DE77 joined.

    Added a safety lock: Players will temporarily lock the event after failing to defeat the three mini-bosses in the Deep Void to prevent unintended retries in the hospital.
    Added a reaction delay to the event to prevent bugs caused by rapid key presses.

New on Steam:

    Achievement for Hidden Ending 1
    Achievement for Ghoul Spider
Fixed the issue where the screen would go black when leaving the Anne event

Added 4 new common random events to each region
Military training of the Supervisory Department has been changed from being displayed as available only at level 10 to being displayed at the beginning, but can only be learned at level 10
Fixed an issue where Soul Eater mutation could trigger multiple times when overkilling with a multi-attack skill.

Fixed the issue where the mission objective numbers in free missions were displayed incorrectly.
Increased the SP requirement for passive skills.

Increase the bullet limit to 9999
Number of gorillas +1

Bug fix:
Fixed the problem that the hospital could not clear new mutations

Hotprotato boss battle added new bgm. (Thanks to hotprotato for the friendly contribution)
Fixed the satiety system missing English translation.

Fixed an issue with Arakal not resurrecting.
Fixed the issue where player did not complete the quest after challenging Liesa.
Fixed an issue where some portals in the Wild Area were not translated.

Fixed a bug where players could use suicide skills while learning skills.
Fixed a bug where some passive skills that can be switched on and off cannot be used.

notes.title: 1.0 patch note
notes.content:
Test Subject:
Void Foundation: Into the Void has officially launched version 1.0 on May 23.

Additionally, there will be a one-week discount starting from the launch date.

[previewyoutube=D-0AuIeaODE;full][/previewyoutube]

Below are the new features added in version 1.0:

    New Hunger System: Players must regularly replenish their hunger; otherwise, combat ability will decrease.

    New Void Incursion System: Spending a long time in the Void will make battles more difficult, but you will gain more experience.

    New Quest Board: Players can accept free quests at the Foundation headquarters, with a maximum of three active at once. Each time you enter a new area, more quests will be available.

    New Summons:
        Annie
        Golden Mouse
        Void Slime

    More Boss Battles

    New Random Events

    New Items

    New Support Items

    New Equipment

The market in the northern city now sells various suspicious items. The effects remain the same, but the success rate is only half, and prices are cheaper than those sold by the Foundation. This may help those who have limited Void Coins.

    Players can now flee from battles but will face penalties.

    Reworked Time System: In the second playthrough, players will inherit half of their levels.

    New Mental Collapse:
        Distrust (Effect: Randomly attack allies for 3 turns)

    New Mutations:
        Soul Chaos: 50% chance each turn to gain a random buff; otherwise, gain a random debuff.
        Bone Spikes: Reflect 50% of physical damage taken back to the enemy as spike damage; cannot equip armor.
        Soul Eater: Restore 33% VE for each enemy killed, but decrease all allies' SAN by 33 points.
        Bone Plating: Gain a shield that absorbs one hit each turn, but has a 33% chance to fail when acting.
        Cute Tail: Reduces generated threat by 69%, but has a 33% chance to lose balance when taking damage.

    New Passive Skills:
        Sword Mage: After using a physical attack, increase MAT by 20%. After using a magic attack, increase ATK by 20%. Lasts for one action; cannot be learned by Liesa.
        First Strike Victory: Deal +10% damage when attacking opponents with lower AGI.
        Unmatched Warrior: Deal +10% damage when your VS is full.
        Battlefield Dancer: Gain a +15% ATK buff if you evade an attack, lasting one action. Duration can stack.
        Backstabber: Deal +8% damage to provoked enemies; they deal -8% damage to you.
        Nine Lives Cat: When VS <= 1, increase evasion and magic evasion by 12%.
        Executioner: Deal +10% damage when attacking targets with less than half VS.
        Unique Eye: All physical attacks have a 4% chance to blind the target (ignores resistance if not immune), but triggering blindness reduces your damage by 70%. Can be toggled on/off.
        Calm and Collected: Take -10% damage if your AGI is lower than the attacker’s.
        Follow-Up Attack: Each effect of suppression, confusion, or fear on the target increases your damage by +4%.
        Armor Weakness Specialist: Each effect of armor break increases your damage by +5%.
        Addict: If affected by any addiction effect, increase evasion and magic evasion by 12%.
        Killing Frenzy: Killing an enemy with a physical attack grants +20% ATK for 2 turns.
        Avoid Critical Hits: If damage taken exceeds 30% of your max VS, reduce that damage by 15%.
        Crouch and Defend: Take -15% damage if suppressed, confused, or in fear.
        Mine Expert: If physically attacked, deal half your magic damage as fire damage to the attacker 50% of the time. Bale exclusive; can be toggled on/off.
        Berserker: Physical damage increases by 50%, restoring 10% of damage dealt as VS. However, incoming damage increases by 50%, and you can no longer evade attacks. Can be toggled on/off.
        Hit Correction: Each miss increases hit chance by 8%, stacking until a hit occurs.
        Limb Specialist: All physical attacks have a 33% chance to inflict crippled status, but final damage is reduced by 15%. Can be toggled on/off.
        Psychic Defense: Reduce incoming damage by 10% when attacked. Cannot coexist with Duel Master. Can be toggled on/off.
        Duel Master: Reduce incoming damage by 10% when attacked. Cannot coexist with Psychic Defense. Can be toggled on/off.

    Numerous balance adjustments

    Numerous bug fixes

Fixed some minor bugs.
Hospital is now reopening to treat mutation.

notes.title: Chapter 3_version 0.685
notes.content:
Dear D-class personnel,
Void Foundation: Into The Void
Chapter 3 is officially completed.

[h1]Let’s take a look at what’s going to happen in Chapter 3:[/h1]
[h2]Input combo system:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=wfp50AJ-Iy4;full][/previewyoutube]

Because the difficulty of Chapter 3 will be further increased significantly, the Foundation will give you the new "Void Energy Overload Combo" skill this time.

[h2]At the same time, we will introduce some new combination weapons:[/h2]
Sword + Gun = Gun Blade
Dagger + Crossbow = Hidden Blade
Hammer + Spirit Fire/Dark Ice/White Thunder Magic = Enchanted Mace
Ax + Spear = Halberd
Great Sword + Laser Cutter = Laser Great Sword
Warhammer + Acid/Wither/Gravity Magic = Enchanted Warhammer
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44960619/14d2d3a4ed7abd69e0c1305a5b0171349ab76d70.png[/img]

This means that your character can not only use the skills of two weapons at the same time.
And you can now mix different weapon skills in Void Energy Overload combos.
And players who like to play magicians can also have more magic choices.

[h2]In Chapter 3, the mechanics of the new map:[/h2]
The mechanics of this new map will revolve around a magical relic called the Mirror Relic.

[previewyoutube=JibvqtEu2mk;full][/previewyoutube]

Players will use the Mirror Relic to switch back and forth between the real world and the mirror world.
Many puzzles will revolve around this mechanism.

[h2]New enemies, new challenges[/h2]
This time the enemy will have a reinforcements mechanism. Only by fighting quickly can you avoid being surrounded by enemies.
Some enemies will also appear in the form of eggs, destroy them as soon as possible to prevent them from transforming into stronger enemies!
[previewyoutube=0Tfxz2ipjw8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Sad plot[/h2]
The theme of Chapter 3 is precisely tragedy. You'll discover more of the Foundation's dark side! ?

[h2]There’s more! [/h2]
New random events
New BOSS battle
New crafting recipes
New skills
New Relic
Re balance some of the old skills(Different weapons can now cooperate with each other to produce additional effects.)

[h2]Limited time special offer! [/h2]
That's right! In order to recruit more void adventurers, the Foundation will launch a special offer for two weeks!
If you want to be a void adventurer, now is the perfect time to join us!
